verdict.rationale: A documented public API is a fair question for an authenticator product, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the pack documents a public API for driving Microsoft Authenticator programmatically. Every documented interaction is manual in-app use (scanning QR codes, tapping Approve, toggling settings), and the OpenAPI probes all returned 404. Export and backup features are adjacent data-portability functions, not an API, and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API
